message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on souvenir water globes (snow globes) of PVC. Snow globes are generally classified in heading 9505 as festive, carnival or other entertainment articles. Other rulings put them in 3926.40 as statuettes and other ornamental articles of plastics.

A 45mm water globe with a marine animal that is a souvenir is likely a decorative ornament, so 3926.40.0090 would fit. Many rulings on snow globes, though, hold that non-Christmas snow globes fall under 3926.40.0090, while Christmas-themed ones fall under 9505.10. Since this one is a souvenir with marine animals and no festive theme, 3926.40.0090 is the better fit.

The current statistical suffix for 3926.40.00 is 3926.40.0010 for statuettes and 3926.40.0090 for other. I'll go with 3926.40.0090.
